_doc: Width gate (phase 5): text budget per window variant, measured in-game. chars = half-width characters per line (8 px each, both renderers), lines = lines per page or box. status: measured (shot) or guess. engine = the budget is below what English needs; widen the window or relocate before translating that set (D4: engine work first). Shots are under work/qa/ (gitignored; regenerate with the commands in docs/re/font.md). Field renderer reserves '@' (+ decimal = raw glyph code) and '\' (escapes); a double ASCII space draws a full-width space.

msg.what: field message box: SCN message ops (3b 02), dialogue and narration
msg.wrap: auto (renderer breaks at the right edge); a 5th line opens a new page after the page mark
msg.shot: work/qa/gate/inn/w001034.png (28-char ruler exact), work/qa/one/f001300.png (36 chars wrap after 28), work/qa/gate2/inn.png (6 lines: 4 shown, page mark at x 265 over the 4th line's last cell)

vis.what: VIS/MES caption (640x480, BIOS-font renderer with the tools/asm/vis_ascii.asm hook)
vis.wrap: none: break lines with \n; centre with leading spaces (JP centres the same way)

item_name.what: SMX item names: field item list (x 77, count at 226) and shop list (x 71, price column from ~232)
item_name.status: measured (geometry: menu list 18, shop 20; battle item list not reached yet - take the smaller when it is)
item_name.storage: SMX pool strings keep their byte length today (JP 4-14 bytes): growing the pool needs its u16 offsets relocated (phase 7)

skill_name.what: SMX KIES/SHINOBU names (sword techniques, magic) in the field/battle lists
skill_name.status: guess (= item list geometry; the tour's hero has no magic, list never drawn)

item_desc.what: SMX descriptions: field item/magic description box (x 54..265) and shop description box (x 22..209)
item_desc.wrap: auto (JP descriptions up to 29 full-width chars have no line break)
item_desc.status: measured (22 chars shown in the field box with room for ~26; shop box geometry 22)

battle_msg.what: battle message banner (EXE strings, e.g. 0x16e8 party wiped out), page mark at the right edge
battle_msg.status: measured (20-char ruler + geometry to the page mark)

system_msg.what: EXE messages shown in the description box (e.g. 0x13d0 no usable magic)

choice.what: choice window options (SCN data runs, op 7d tables)
choice.status: measured (18-char options in the 18-byte JP slots: the window is right-anchored at x 278 and sized from the byte count at the JP 6 px per byte, so ASCII at 8 px overflows by a quarter; 14 chars fit an 18-byte window)
choice.engine: size the choice window at 8 px per ASCII byte (op 7d handler), then the budget is the screen width; storage is the data run's byte length (in place, phase 7)

menu_label.what: field main menu (2 columns x 3 rows, x 26 / 58), item/magic title tab, status ailment
menu_label.status: measured (geometry: JP 2 kanji = 24 px; the 4-char marker spills over the frame)
menu_label.engine: too small for English (Items, Magic, Equip, Status, Config, Save): widen the menu windows

battle_command.engine: too small for English (Attack, Defend, Magic, Sword, Item, Flee): widen

status_box.what: field status box title (character name) and battle status header
